Hallway mein gym bas ek gym tha. Agency bas kaghaz thi. Ek-star ek fossil tha.
Wo apne side pe so gayi — tumhari baanh allowed, koi khel zaroori nahi — ek billion-dollar darwaza toda gaya taaki ek ladki keh sake *main accept karti hoon* aur matlab ho *main tumhari hoon.*
Lexi ruk gayi.
